**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Cannot resume {module}: module references `{first}` and `{second}` share the browser name `{name}`; rename one import
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Import one of the two values under another exported name (re-export it from a small module) so their module reference names differ.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { fmt } from "./a";
import { fmt as fmt2 } from "./b";
export function A() { return <List items={[fmt, fmt2]} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
import { fmt } from "./a";
import { fmtB } from "./b-reexport";
export function A() { return <List items={[fmt, fmtB]} />; }
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode. Module reference names are `<name>$<unit hash>$ref`; only a unit hash collision (5 base-36 digits over the module id + exported name) between two values one module references can trigger it — not reproducible on demand.
